class.name: NetwPredictJudgement
class.brief_description: Whether a prediction was wrong, returned by [method NetwMultiplayer._predict_evaluate].
class.description: Create one with [method of] in an override of [method NetwMultiplayer._predict_evaluate]. [codeblock] var judged := NetwPredictJudgement.of(INF, true) [/codeblock]

method.name: corrected
method.description: [code]true[/code] when the prediction must be corrected.

method.name: divergence
method.description: The largest error of any property, or [code]INF[/code] when there was nothing to compare.
